baseline_models.mechanism: An event-like day gathers the Spirit and the angels into upright, level alignment; posture and row make order visible before any speech occurs.

activation_trace.role: The day as a severe occurrence supplies the assembly's event frame.
Bodily rising and standing supplies the assembly's upright posture.
Life-bearing spirit supplies the distinct principal named before the angels.
The angel branch identifies the accompanying heavenly plurality.
Alignment on a level line converts plurality into a disciplined formation.

changed_reading.before: The Spirit and angels are simply present on a future day.
changed_reading.after: They take an upright, visibly ordered formation whose discipline precedes and conditions the speech scene.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: لَّا يَتَكَلَّمُونَ إِلَّا مَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابًا
baseline_models.mechanism: The exception imposes two gates: the speaker must receive permission from the Merciful, and the resulting utterance must itself be right.

activation_trace.role: Intelligible speech between parties supplies the act placed under prohibition.
Permission and authorization supply the speaker-admission gate.
Mercy and beneficent tenderness characterize the authority that opens the gate.
Voiced saying supplies the admitted output.
Correctness opposed to error supplies the content-admission gate.

changed_reading.before: A general silence is interrupted whenever permission is given.
changed_reading.after: Speech is a doubly admitted act: authorization qualifies the speaker, while correctness qualifies what is said.

baseline_models.mechanism: قيام can mark undertaking and sustained care as well as posture, so the line may be an ordered assumption of office rather than a merely static pose.

activation_trace.role: Rising with resolve to an affair turns standing into active undertaking.
Care, preservation, and governance give the undertaking an official function.
Angels understood through message-bearing service supply agents of the office.
The straight row distributes that service into coordinated positions.

changed_reading.before: The verse describes who is physically standing.
changed_reading.after: The verse may also describe a coordinated corps taking up and maintaining its assigned charge.

baseline_models.mechanism: The hearing-and-acceptance branch of أذن and the target-hitting branch of صواب allow the exception to concern uptake and efficacy, not license alone.

activation_trace.role: Listening and accepting the heard supplies a possible reception side to permission.
Voiced saying supplies the utterance offered for reception.
Aiming and hitting the intended target supplies communicative efficacy.

changed_reading.before: The permitted person may emit a correct sentence.
changed_reading.after: The admitted saying may be one that is received and reaches its intended mark.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah's speech economy reverses: reciprocal questioning and divergent routes at the opening become worthless noise excluded and address unavailable, until the focus permits only a right utterance.

activation_trace.role: Reciprocal questioning supplies the opening's uncontrolled many-sided discourse.
Each party taking a different route supplies discursive divergence.
Mixed vocal noise supplies the kind of speech removed near the close.
Exchange of address supplies the capacity explicitly unavailable immediately before the focus.
Intelligible speech is the focus act into which the surah's discourse is narrowed.
Authorization replaces reciprocal access with controlled admission.
Correctness resolves the earlier divergence without reopening general debate.

structural_cues: 78:1-3 opens with reciprocal questioning about a matter on which parties diverge.
78:35-38 closes with excluded noise, unavailable address, then a permission-and-correctness exception.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the opening dispute and closing restrictions; I infer a whole-surah contraction from many voices to one admissible kind of saying. A live alternative is that the passages describe separate populations without a discourse arc.

changed_reading.before: The focus imposes local courtroom decorum.
changed_reading.after: The focus closes the surah's contested discourse by replacing mutual questioning and divergence with a single authorized, reality-aligned speech channel.

context_deltas.mechanism: The created canopy is first assembled and strong, then opened into entrances while mountains are removed into mirage; against that unbuilding, the upright row becomes a reconstituted form of order.

activation_trace.role: Joining parts into a building supplies the surah's initial cosmic architecture.
Strength and solidity characterize that architecture as stable.
The opening of what was closed begins the architecture's loss of enclosure.
Entrances replace the formerly continuous canopy with passages.
Displacement and removal strip the landscape of its fixed supports.
Mirage supplies apparent form without stable mass.
Straightness and equilibrium supply a new upright stability.
Level alignment supplies organized form after fixed cosmic forms dissolve.

structural_cues: 78:12 presents a joined, strong structure above.
78:19-20 converts sky to openings and mountains to mirage before 78:38 presents standing alignment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies stable construction followed by opening and displacement; I infer that the row visually reconstitutes order after cosmic supports fail. The live alternative is simple stage sequence with no replacement relation.

changed_reading.before: The row is a ceremonial arrangement within the judgment scene.
changed_reading.after: The row is also the scene's surviving or newly constituted order after built enclosure and mountain solidity have been undone.

context_deltas.mechanism: Separation by judgment, proportionate correspondence, exhaustive enumeration, binding record, and reality-match turn صواب from generic propriety into speech fitted to an already discriminated and recorded reality.

activation_trace.role: Judgment separating truth from falsehood supplies the decisive standard.
A measure equal to its counterpart supplies exact correspondence.
Exhaustive counting supplies evidentiary completeness.
Written establishment that entails judgment supplies a fixed record.
Stable conformity to reality supplies the final truth criterion.
The voiced saying is the item tested against the record.
Hitting an intended target turns correctness into precise evidentiary fit.

structural_cues: The appointed day is named by separation in 78:17.
78:26 and 78:29 pair matching recompense with exhaustive inscription; 78:39 names the day real.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies discrimination, matching, enumeration, inscription, and reality; I infer that the permitted saying must land against that fixed account. A live alternative is that صواب means moral correctness without a specifically evidentiary function.

changed_reading.before: The authorized speaker says something generally good or correct.
changed_reading.after: The authorized speaker gives an exact, checkable saying that fits the separated judgment and exhaustive record rather than revising it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Wind is sent in the trumpet, human cohorts arrive, and later the Spirit and angels stand aligned; the shared wind-life field and event sequence turn the focus from a static tableau into a breathed muster that regularizes arriving plurality.

activation_trace.role: Sending wind into something supplies the activating blast.
Coming and arrival supply the blast's following movement.
Human groups supply the unaligned plurality entering the scene.
Wind and breath give the named Spirit a life-air resonance without fixing its identity.
Resurrection-event standing places the posture in the register of the summons.
The level row converts gathered plurality into ordered muster.

structural_cues: 78:18 and 78:38 both begin their scenes with يَوْمَ.
The earlier scene moves blast to arrival in groups; the focus moves standing to a row.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies wind-sending, arrival, groups, Spirit, standing, and row; I supply the temporal arrow from summons to muster and treat the wind-life overlap as resonance. The live alternative is that روح is simply a distinct named being and the two scenes are not causally linked.

changed_reading.before: The focus is a motionless heavenly audience.
changed_reading.after: The focus can be the ordered completion of a breath-initiated gathering: cohorts arrive, while the Spirit and angels take formation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The near context filters what is heard and denies autonomous address; this activates أذن as listening/acceptance, so the exception governs successful uptake as well as vocal permission.

activation_trace.role: Auditory reception makes what reaches hearers part of the speech mechanism.
Speech discarded as uncounted supplies the rejected reception class.
Reciprocal address supplies the communicative relation no participant controls.
Listening and accepting supplies the uptake that completes authorized speech.
Intelligible connection between speakers supplies the full communicative circuit.
Target-hitting supplies the criterion that the received utterance has landed.

structural_cues: 78:35 describes the absence of heard verbal waste.
78:37 denies possessed address before 78:38 opens a narrow exception.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hearing, excluded verbal waste, unavailable address, and the hearing branch of أذن; I infer a two-sided communication gate. The live alternative is that أذن remains pure authorization and hearing contributes only local contrast.

changed_reading.before: Permission concerns only whether a speaker may begin talking.
changed_reading.after: Permission can also mark divine reception: admissible speech is heard, accepted, and effective rather than merely emitted.

context_deltas.mechanism: Sovereign lordship gives a gift, while no creature controls address; permission from the Merciful therefore appears as a bestowed capacity rather than a speaker's owned entitlement.

activation_trace.role: Lordship, ownership, and sovereignty identify the source of allocation.
Giving and handing over supply the nearby grammar of bestowal.
Address supplies the capacity immediately said not to be under creaturely control.
Authorization is the act by which that unowned capacity is granted.
Merciful beneficence characterizes the grant rather than bare coercion.
The resulting saying is exercised as a conferred capacity.

structural_cues: 78:36-38 moves from gift, to non-possession of address, to permission by the Merciful.
The giver and permitter are framed by رب and الرحمن in the immediate sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sovereign giving, unowned address, and merciful permission; I infer that permission is itself gift-like. The live alternative is that the gift concerns reward alone and the speech rule remains a separate judicial restriction.

changed_reading.before: Permission is an external veto lifted for selected speakers.
changed_reading.after: The very ability to address is not possessed in advance; it is mercifully bestowed for a right use.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the form يَتَكَلَّمُونَ plainly foregrounds speaking, not bodily wounding. It remains anchored in the packet's ك ل م wound branch and is activated by separation and a wound carrying fixed liability; downstream prose should retain it only as a juridical metaphor for the cutting consequence of admitted words, never as the verse's direct translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يَتَكَلَّمُونَ, through the ك ل م branch 'an injuring mark in the body'

activation_trace.role: A wound as an enduring bodily mark gives speech a secondary cutting-consequence image.
Separation that exposes a boundary supplies the utterance's discriminating cut.
A wound with obligatory liability supplies the juridical consequence of making such a mark.
Target-hitting constrains the metaphorical incision to a precise, authorized effect.

changed_reading.after: As a contained secondary resonance, the admitted word is a precise juridical incision that separates and leaves an accountable mark.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because صَفًّا ordinarily depicts a row of agents, while the cited branch depicts smooth level ground. It remains anchored in ص ف ف and is materially activated by mountains being removed into mirage and by dust; downstream prose should present a spatial overlay of exposed levelness, not replace the ordinary formation reading.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: صَفًّا, through the ص ف ف branch of smooth level ground

activation_trace.role: Smooth, bare level ground supplies a spatial layer beneath the ordinary row.
Raised solid masses supply the relief that is about to disappear.
Removal clears the fixed elevations from the imagined plane.
Mirage replaces solid relief with visually unstable flatness.
Earth and dust supply the terminal material image of undifferentiated ground.

changed_reading.before: صَفًّا only describes agents arranged in a line.
changed_reading.after: The line may also be visualized against an exposed, levelled field after mountainous relief loses substance.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because 78:39 does not explicitly identify the right saying with taking a return. It remains anchored in قول as an adopted position and صواب as reaching a goal, while the next ayah supplies willing, taking, and return; downstream prose should frame it as a possible performative force of the utterance, not specify its speaker or content.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: وَقَالَ صَوَابًا, through قول as a held position and صواب as target-reaching

activation_trace.role: A saying as belief or adopted position supplies commitment-bearing force.
Reaching the intended target lets the committed word orient action.
Will directed toward a thing supplies volitional uptake.
Taking and adopting supplies the move from position to chosen course.
Return to a destination supplies the course's endpoint.

changed_reading.before: The right saying is only a declarative report.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it can carry the force of a true commitment that takes a course of return toward its target.

strongest_changes: The speech ban became the whole surah's closure of reciprocal questioning and divergence, not isolated decorum.
صَوَابًا became exact fit to separation, proportionate recompense, exhaustive record, and reality.
Permission became a mercifully granted and received capacity for address, not merely a lifted veto.
The standing row became dynamic order after blast-driven gathering and after cosmic architecture loses stability.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah sequencing linked discourse, material order, accounting, and bestowal back to the focus without collapsing them into one final interpretation; the strongest latent shift was from generic silence to a tightly governed channel whose utterance must be owned by neither speaker nor dispute and must fit reality.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet does not resolve the identity or precise scope of ٱلرُّوحُ.
The hearing branch of أَذِنَ may be active resonance while the construction still primarily denotes permission.
Record-fit does not reveal who speaks or the specific content of the right saying.
Breath, juridical wound, level ground, and return-as-speech-act remain secondary exploratory overlays rather than lexical replacements.
